entries.question: How to take appointment
entries.answer:
To take an appointment at KGMU, please note that online registration is mandatory. You can use any of the following methods:

**1. Online Registration System (ORS)**
*   **Website:** [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in)
*   **Process:** Login/register → Select Uttar Pradesh → Select KGMU → Click "New Appointment" → Choose department, date, and time → Enter patient details → Pay the ₹50 fee → Download your appointment slip.

**2. ABHA / Health Care App**
*   Register using your mobile number and OTP, then follow the same state and hospital selection flow as the ORS portal.

**3. SMS Service**
*   Send an SMS in the format `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` to **8887019134**.

**4. Walk-in Registration**
*   Bring your Aadhaar card and an active mobile number.
*   Complete the OTP verification at the counter.
*   Pay the ₹50 fee to receive a physical token and your OPD slip.

**Important Information:**
*   **OPD Timings:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM; Saturday, 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM (Closed on Sundays).
*   **Fee:** The OPD slip fee is ₹50 regardless of the booking method.
*   **Referrals:** Patients arriving from outside the city must bring a valid referral for the specific department.
*   **Recommendation:** Pre-booking is strongly advised to avoid long wait times. The ticket/parchi counter closes at 1:00 PM sharp.

For further assistance, you may contact the KGMU helpline at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.

3. **SMS dwara:**

entries.question: Mujhe Lab Technician ka pura details chahiye
entries.answer:
KGMU mein Lab Technician ki bharti ya vacancy se sambandhit jaankari ke liye aap niche diye gaye madhyamon ka upyog kar sakte hain:

1. **Official Website:** KGMU ki adhikarik website [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) par "General Notices" ya "Recruitment" section ko niyamit roop se check karte rahein.
2. **Notice Board:** KGMU ke notice board par samay-samay par naye project ya vibhagon mein khali padon ki jaankari prakashit ki jaati hai. Aap [https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php) par jaakar latest notices dekh sakte hain.
3. **Qualification:** Aamtaur par Lab Technician ke pad ke liye DMLT (Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology) ya BMLT (Bachelor in Medical Laboratory Technology) aur paramedical council mein panjikaran (registration) anivarya hota hai. 
4. **Current Updates:** Filhal, 31 July 2026 ko "Advertise the vacant project (Spiking) positions" (Ref: 605/R-Cell-26) ka notice jaari hua hai. Aap ise [yahan click karke](https://www.kgmu.org/upload_file/user_download/86097f537228cb1ab13ae6fbaaf1c70e.pdf) dekh sakte hain ki kya usmein Lab Technician ke liye koi pad hai.

**Salah:** KGMU mein bharti se sambandhit kisi bhi avaidh call ya sandesh se savdhan rahein. Sabhi adhikarik jaankari sirf website par hi uplabdh hoti hai. Yadi aap kisi vishesh project ya vibhag ke bare mein puchna chahte hain, toh kripya spasht karein.
